dedupe_keys.name: estaciones de tratamiento de agua potable etap en la comunidad de madrid

description: Estaciones de Tratamiento de Agua Potable (ETAP) en la Comunidad de Madrid is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idem.comunidad.madrid. Location of Drinking Water Treatment Stations (DWTPs), From their collection to the tap of the consumer, the waters are subject to a strict monitoring program in order to ensure that at all times the quality of the water is in accordance with the provisions of current legislation on water intended for human consumption. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking Water Treatment Stations (ETAP) in the Community of Madrid" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include IDEM, Comunidad de Madrid, Agua, Medio Ambiente. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
